Use case: stylized-concept. Premium detailed voxel 3D architectural diorama for THE COMPANIONS, honey-oak and crafted painted cabinetry, finely stepped rounded bevels, realistic layered warm materials, tactile tiny voxels, physically convincing soft lighting/contact shadows. Every furniture piece needs individually resolved legs, joints, hardware, edge details; plants need species diversity; textiles need visible weave, trim and seams. Full object density of official reference, expanded usable space instead of clutter. Canonical human height 1.70m, room approximately 4.8m x 4.6m, desks about 1.5m wide and .75m high. Always a FUNCTIONAL StudyZone: tabletop clear central area, chair correctly facing work surface with leg clearance, space to pull it back, continuous open walking route from front to seat. Never block path with plants or props. No pets, no bed, no characters, no interface, no watermark, no exterior title text. Crisp standalone landscape 3:2 image, not multi-room contact sheet. Two-wall cutaway isometric gallery presentation, whole floor plinth fits in frame; soft ivory background #f6f2e9. Exact object construction and style family consistent with supplied library master (image2); image1 is the official art direction.
ROOM BRIEF: Lower row third of official reference. A freestanding elevated square park study pavilion with beautiful hipped green glazed-voxel tiled roof, alternating subtly varied overlapping individual tiles, brass finial and crafted wooden rafters. Cutaway/open front roof edge high enough to reveal interior. Four oak columns on substantial limestone pedestals with bolts and mortise joints. Stone steps centered front, low corner flower beds and ferns outside clear stair width. Rear bench with sage cushions and ivory/rust pillows; central side-right rectangular oak desk with green wooden study chair facing open laptop, cream notebook, pen holder, small lamp and mug. Small backpack beside supporting pillar, bronze hanging lanterns and low pathway lanterns, framed botanical sign on right corner. Rich park and calm blue lake backdrop visible between posts, varied leafy trees on both sides, detailed meadow plants and water depth. Roomy interior with a clear center path from stairs to study chair and bench. No planters or objects on steps. Stone joints, roof ridge tiles, timber pegs and woven textiles.
